manifest.description: Historical candidate manifest used for inventory/classification

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomy ID for automatic long-read discovery

soft_download_budget.description: Soft proposed-panel download budget in GB; unique biology may exceed it with a warning

soft_raw_subread_budget.description: Soft count of difficult raw-subread candidates in the proposed panel

approved_manifest.description: Reviewer-approved classification-bearing TSV for production processing

auto_approve_safe.description: Automatically process READY_FOR_REVIEW rows from --manifest and quarantine the rest

metadata_json.description: Optional captured ENA/SRA metadata JSON; omitted to resolve metadata automatically

metadata_cache_dir.description: Optional persistent cache for ENA metadata responses

fastq_cache_dir.description: Persistent shared cache for checksum-validated FASTQ files

reference_fasta.description: Reference FASTA used by minimap2 and TAMA

reference_fai.description: Optional FASTA index to validate alongside the reference

minimap_index.description: Existing minimap2 .mmi; omit to build it

model_backend.description: Independent candidate-model backend; IsoQuant, FLAIR, and Bambu retain their native complete-BAM workflows

backend_merge_mode.description: Merge semantics: native preserves each backend's native format and topology; legacy_common is an explicit compatibility path using merge_tool

backend_failure_policy.description: Exploration policy for backend process failures; continue preserves results from other backends and records failures in the execution trace

tracedir.description: Directory for Nextflow execution reports and trace files

tama_container.description: Pinned TAMA container; required for non-stub execution

ccs_container.description: Validated PacBio CCS container for BAM conversion

ccs_expected_version.description: Expected validated CCS version; required for non-stub BAM processing

merge_tool.description: Deprecated legacy_common-only merge selector; native mode rejects non-default values and selects the backend's native merge workflow

stringtie2_merge_args.description: Additional arguments for StringTie2 --merge; recorded in native provenance

stringtie3_merge_args.description: Additional arguments for StringTie3 --merge; recorded in native provenance

stringtie_merge_scope.description: StringTie native merge topology; only run_then_cohort is currently supported

publish_native_intermediates.description: Publish native run and merge intermediates under the backend-namespaced output tree

shard_mode.description: Split each sorted BAM by reference contig before TAMA; use none only for deliberately small inputs

shard_contig_reads.description: Mapped-read heuristic used to classify large contigs

skip_tama_shards.description: Backward-compatible comma-separated exact run:shard keys to omit from TAMA Collapse

skip_model_shards.description: Comma-separated backend:run:shard keys to omit from model construction

skip_flair_accessions.description: Comma-separated accession IDs to omit from FLAIR transcriptome processing

tama_memory_large.description: Second TAMA allocation after a resource kill

tama_memory_very_large.description: Final TAMA allocation after resource retries

run_diamond_validation.description: Generate longest-ATG ORFs and validate them with Diamond

diamond_annotation_manifest.description: Annotation-only DIAMOND manifest with id, backend, scope, annotation, and optional format columns; bypasses read acquisition, alignment, and model construction

diamond_reference_db.description: Existing Diamond database for combined-model validation

diamond_reference_proteins.description: Reference protein FASTA used to build a Diamond database

ensembl_genes_container.description: Container providing the transcriptomic data selector

transcriptomic_data_command.description: Command used inside the Ensembl genes container to retrieve long-read candidates

isoquant_mode.description: IsoQuant mode; annotation_free is the primary initial-annotation mode

isoquant_data_type.description: Explicit IsoQuant input data type; never inferred from filenames

isoquant_genedb.description: GTF/GFF or gffutils database for reference_guided IsoQuant

isoquant_numba_disable_jit.description: Set NUMBA_DISABLE_JIT=1 for IsoQuant containers whose Numba cache cannot locate read-only package sources; benchmark before production use

isoquant_args.description: Additional IsoQuant arguments; pipeline-owned input, mode, output, and analysis flags are rejected

flair_args.description: Additional FLAIR transcriptome arguments; pipeline-owned inputs are rejected

bambu_install_biocmanager.description: Install the small BiocManager bootstrap into the task-local R library when the pinned Bambu image omits it

bambu_track_reads.description: Retain Bambu read-to-transcript assignments in the native RDS; disable only for a lower-memory structural-only benchmark

bambu_quantify.description: Run Bambu quantification so native read-to-transcript assignments are available; set false for discovery-only mode

bambu_r_lib.description: Optional shared R library containing Bambu runtime dependencies such as BiocManager
